email.subject: Fast Lane Works: two quick fixes worth testing
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I looked at Fast Lane Works Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next shop. And your hours aren't listed anywhere, which makes people call to check (or skip calling at all).

Your site also has no reviews showing and a generic title tag, which hurts how you show up in search, but the booking and hours gaps are probably the bigger loss.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
